responsibility: This file provides the N9 pipeline model for the 3-read/2-write register-port configuration. It defines automaton reservations and MM-to-EX bypass behavior for scalar, multiple-memory, DSP-adjacent, multiply/MAC/divide, and branch classes under the higher-port-count implementation, serving as the scheduling counterpart to nds32-n9-2r1w.md for the alternative N9 microarchitectural register-file design.
